differentialFeed.value: Adjustable differential feed, lever on the left side (Brother page). The 0.7 to 1.0 and 1.0 to 2.0 settings come from the shared family handbook 884-345 (OCR, verify); the 1634D page lists no ratio

presserFootLift.value: 5 to 6 mm (family handbook 884-345, not 1634D-specific; OCR, verify)

warrantyUs.value: Page text: 1/5/25 year limited serger warranty. The generic US serger warranty gives 1 year parts, labor and accessories, 5 years electronic components, 25 years chassis casting; not model-specific, and the PDF linked from the 1634D page is the 1 year international warranty

conflicts: Warranty: our earlier spec said 25-year limited, but that is the chassis casting term only; Brother's 1634D page text says 1/5/25 year limited serger warranty while the PDF linked from that page is the 1 year international warranty XF6323-101, and the 1634DX page links the US serger warranty XB2300-101 (1/5/25), so the model-specific term is not confirmed.

Weight: 17.3 lb appears only in review blogs (sergerpro.com), Brother's 1634D page gives no weight, and the family handbook 884-345 (covering 1034D, 1134DW, 1134D, DZ1234 and 1634D) gives 7.0 kg (15.4 lb); the weight is held as null for the 1634D.
Dimensions: a review blog gives 12.5 x 13.5 x 15 in with no axis order, while Brother's page gives only the carton at 15 x 13 x 14 in; machine dimensions are held as null.
Stitch width: Brother's page says 5.0 to 7.0 mm while the family handbook says 2.3 to 7 mm (OCR, verify); the page figure is used.
Stitch fingers: Brother's page lists 1, while one PatternReview owner says the 1634D has 2.
Threading color coding: Brother's page says color-coded lay-in threading, while one PatternReview owner says the 1634D lacks the color coding of the 1034D.
Stitch count: 22 comes from one review blog (sergerpro.com); Brother lists stitch types without a count.
claims: "Easy to follow, color-coded lay-in threading system" (Brother claim, product page)
"Perfect for finishing, creating rolled hems, inserting zippers, stitching neat blind hems, and creating ruffles" (Brother claim, product page)
"Light- to heavy-weight materials" (Brother claim, family handbook 884-345)
"One of the bestselling and most popular home serger machines" (review-blog claim, mashupfabric.com)
"Cover Stitch Serger" appears in one dealer listing title (mistersewvac.com); Brother lists no coverstitch function

editorial.verdict: A 3/4 thread, 1,300 spm Brother serger on the 1034D platform; owner evidence is thin (8 first-hand Reddit voices) and the only marketplace rating is an eBay catalog page, 4.8 from 45.
editorial.whoFor: A first serger buyer who wants the Brother 3/4 thread platform and can confirm the 1634D suffix, not the 1634DX, at the price on the day.
editorial.skipIf: You want 2-thread stitches, a coverstitch, an LED light or a published throat or motor figure; the 1634DX adds LED and 2/3/4 thread change per Brother's pages, and the Juki MO-654DE steps up.
editorial.keySpec: 3/4 thread · 1,300 spm · differential feed · removable free arm
strengths: Brother lists 3/4 thread overlock, rolled hem, blind hem and gathering at 1,300 spm, with a removable free arm and trim trap.
Brother's page lists a standard foot, blindstitch foot and gathering foot, a soft cover, an instructional video and accessory storage.
Standard SCHMETZ 130/705H household needles per the instruction manual listing, so needle supply is not a special order.
weaknesses: Owner evidence is thin: 9 voices from 8 Reddit threads, and owners report defects such as a front cover that does not close and a broken spool stand shaft, mostly on used units.
Brother publishes no machine weight, machine dimensions, throat space or motor figure for the 1634D; the family handbook figures are shared with other models.
No 2-thread stitch (Brother lists 2/3/4 thread change as No) and no coverstitch, despite one dealer title saying cover stitch.

checks.title: Confirm the suffix
checks.body: The 1634D and 1634DX are separate Brother pages: the DX lists LED and a different carton, the D lists a bulb. Match the label on the box to the page you read.

checks.title: Ask which warranty applies
checks.body: The 1634D page text says 1/5/25 year, but its linked PDF is the 1 year international warranty. The US serger warranty is linked from the 1634DX page. Get the term in writing from the seller.

checks.title: Treat weight and size as unverified
checks.body: Brother gives only a 15 x 13 x 14 in carton for the 1634D. Measure your shelf against the carton, not against blog dimensions.

realCost: Serger thread: a 4-thread overlock needs 4 cones, and the page lists no starter set
Spare 130/705H needles, since the handbook set is sizes 80 and 90
Serger oil for the maintenance the handbook describes
A replacement 15 watt bulb of the same type, per the handbook lamp note

faqs.q: What is the difference between the Brother 1634D and the 1034D?
faqs.a: Both are 3/4 thread differential feed sergers sharing handbook 884-345. Forum owners report differences in dial location, color coding and stitch fingers; Brother's 1634D page lists 1 stitch finger. Treat the suffix as a different listing, not a spec.

faqs.q: What is the difference between the 1634D and the 1634DX?
faqs.a: Brother lists the 1634DX with an LED light and the 1634D with a bulb. Both pages list 3/4 thread, 1 stitch finger, 5.0 to 7.0 mm seam width and 1,300 spm. The 1634DX page links the US serger warranty; the 1634D page links an international one.
Brother's 1634D page showed no discontinuation notice on 2026-10-02 and listed a price of $299.99. We make no claim about other pages: the R1634D, 1734D and 1534D Brother pages returned 404 that day.

faqs.q: Does the Brother 1634D have a free arm?
faqs.a: Yes. Brother describes a removable free arm.

faqs.q: Can the Brother 1634D do a coverstitch?
faqs.a: No coverstitch function appears on Brother's page. One dealer listing title says cover stitch; that is retailer wording.

faqs.q: What needles does the Brother 1634D take?
faqs.a: SCHMETZ 130/705H household needles per the manual listing. The family handbook set is two size 80 and two size 90; one accessory line reads 130/705M in OCR, so verify against the PDF.

faqs.q: How much does the Brother 1634D weigh?
faqs.a: Brother's 1634D page gives no weight. A family handbook shared with the 1034D, 1134DW, 1134D and DZ1234 gives 7.0 kg (15.4 lb); a blog gives 17.3 lb. Neither is a confirmed 1634D figure.

faqs.q: What is the differential feed range?
faqs.a: The 1634D page lists no ratio. The shared family handbook gives 0.7 to 1.0 and 1.0 to 2.0 settings (OCR, verify).

faqs.q: What is the stitch width and length?
faqs.a: Brother's page says 5.0 to 7.0 mm seam width. The family handbook says 2.3 to 7 mm width and 2 to 4 mm stitch length (OCR, verify).

faqs.q: What feet come with the Brother 1634D?
faqs.a: Brother lists a standard foot, blindstitch foot and gathering foot, plus a soft cover, an instructional video and a printed manual.
